question: What is the meaning of end of life percentage in relation to efficiency of recycling process?
description: The end of life percentage in relation to the efficiency of the recycling process indicates the proportion of materials that are either recycled, reused, or safely disposed of at the end of a building's life cycle. This percentage reflects the effectiveness of the recycling process and the ability to recover materials for future use, thereby contributing to the circular economy.
